baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَّبَيَّنَ لَكُم مِّن مَّسَاكِنِهِمْ ... وَكَانُوا مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Outward disclosure from settled sites and inward heart-sight flank the account of diversion. The failure is therefore not lack of available evidence or perceptual capacity but failure of discernment to govern movement.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of emergence and disclosure makes the dwellings disclose evidence rather than merely contain it.
The branch image of inhabiting a home supplies concrete settled sites as the medium of disclosure.
The branch image of heart-sight supplies active inward discernment and makes the cognition-conduct split explicit.

changed_reading.before: They went astray because they failed to see what was true.
changed_reading.after: They were diverted while external evidence was clear and inward discernment was available; seeing did not become governing commitment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence runs through valuation rather than information: intentional deeds are made to look good, their authors remain active, and that attractive action-loop diverts them from a traversable route.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of displaying and improving beauty supplies the altered valuation of the deeds.
The branch image of the rebellious, overstepping shaytan supplies the agent that engineers the altered valuation.
The branch image of purposive action makes their own intentional conduct the medium of capture.
The branch image of turning away and turning another supplies the resulting redirection.
The branch image of an extended traversable road supplies the course from which action is redirected.

changed_reading.before: An external tempter simply blocks an otherwise unseen road.
changed_reading.after: Diversion is mediated by attractive revaluation of their own purposive conduct: they keep acting while agency is rerouted.

baseline_models.mechanism: A dwelling arrests motion and establishes a place of permanence, yet here the settled places outlast their occupants only as evidence. The technology of stability is reversed into testimony against permanence.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of motion ceasing supplies the stabilizing function that the ruined site reverses.
The branch image of a place of settled rest supplies the material locus that survives as witness.
The branch image of becoming manifest converts the former place of stability into legible testimony.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings merely identify where the peoples once lived.
changed_reading.after: Their instruments of settlement are precisely what survive to expose the failure of their claim to durable stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence tests professed security by separating truthful claim from evil work and faulty judgment. Applied to مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ, insight is equipment under assay; beautification causes failure at the transfer from judgment to action.

activation_trace.role: Heart-sight supplies the cognitive capacity whose practical force is being tested.
The branch image of assaying metal or a person supplies a test that reveals what cognition is worth in conduct.
The branch image of making a promise or act real supplies behavioral verification rather than verbal correctness alone.
The branch image of purposive work places intended deeds, the same medium as the focus ayah, under the assay.
The branch image of accurate wisdom supplies the evaluative standard that their judgment misses.

structural_cues: 29:2-4 progress from an untested claim through assay and truth-verification to evil works and bad judgment.
The focus ayah likewise ends with a cognition term only after describing the action that diverted its possessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, enacted truth, purposive work, and sound judgment; I infer that insight is tested by whether it rules action, while the live alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ marks worldly competence rather than moral discernment.

changed_reading.before: They possessed evidence but neglected to use it.
changed_reading.after: Their insight is a capacity under behavioral assay; beautified work reveals that cognition failed to become truthful judgment in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken invitation to follow 'our path' is coupled to a promise that others will carry the resulting errors, then reversed into multiplied burdens. Path-blocking can therefore work by recruitment onto a rival route backed by false moral outsourcing.

activation_trace.role: Turning another away supplies the focus ayah's blocked movement that the rival invitation operationalizes.
The branch image of following behind supplies recruitment into a socially led route.
The extended traversable road supplies an explicit competing path rather than mere aimlessness.
The branch image of bearing an entrusted burden or guilt supplies the promised transfer of liability and its denial.
The branch image of loading a burden supplies the later multiplication that exposes the outsourcing promise.

structural_cues: 29:12 repeats the focus root س ب ل inside an imperative to follow a possessive rival path.
29:13 immediately replaces promised substitution with accumulated personal and additional loads.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, a rival path, and failed burden transfer; I infer that beautification may recruit through reassuring social speech, while the live alternative is that the burden exchange is a separate polemic about responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Satanic diversion leaves people without a route.
changed_reading.after: Diversion may install a socially sponsored rival route whose appeal includes the fiction that someone else can absorb its consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Falsehood is actively fabricated, becomes mutual affection, receives public performance in an assembly, and includes cutting the road. Beautified deeds are thus a social aesthetic that produces belonging and then reproduces obstruction through its participants.

activation_trace.role: Displayed beauty supplies the attractive surface that can become collectively shared.
Purposive deeds supply the repeated conduct through which the shared valuation becomes social fact.
The branch image of fabricating false speech supplies active production rather than passive error.
The branch image of falsehood turned away from truth supplies the fabricated content.
The branch image of mutual love supplies the bonding reward that stabilizes the fabrication among people.
The branch image of a people's council and gathering supplies the public venue of normalization.
The branch image of reprehensible conduct that should be checked supplies what the assembly instead performs.
The explicit branch image of road-cutting by seizure or obstruction turns diverted agents into obstructors of others.
The traversable road supplies the public route their normalized conduct severs.

structural_cues: 29:17, 29:25, and 29:29 move from making falsehood to relational affection to assembly-level practice.
The same path root as the focus ayah appears where agents themselves cut the route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fabrication, bonding, assembly, reprehensible action, and road-cutting; I infer a propagation chain from attractive valuation to communal obstruction, while the live alternative is that these are independent features of separate episodes.

changed_reading.before: Beautification is a private distortion inside each wrongdoer.
changed_reading.after: Beautification can become a shared culture: fabricated value bonds a group, gains public performance, and makes the diverted into path-blockers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context instructs movement through the land and directed looking, then names an intentionally remaining clear sign for people who restrain error by reason. The focus dwellings become a repeatable field observation rather than inherited report.

activation_trace.role: Manifest disclosure supplies the evidentiary result obtained from the sites.
Places of settled rest supply the material observation sites.
The branch image of eye-sight and insight supplies direct perception as an evidentiary operation.
The branch image of moving and proceeding supplies travel to the observable field.
The branch image of directing eye or insight supplies deliberate inspection rather than casual seeing.
The branch image of leaving an effect behind supplies the persistence of material evidence.
The branch image of a manifest sign assigns evidentiary function to the surviving trace.
The branch image of intellect restraining ignorance supplies the required conversion of observation into judgment.

structural_cues: 29:19-20 pair seeing with travel and directed inspection of terrestrial beginnings.
29:35 says an effect was left as a clear sign immediately before the focus's appeal to dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, inspection, a left trace, a manifest sign, and restraining intellect; I infer a field-evidence workflow culminating in the focus dwellings, while the live alternative is that the travel command concerns creation generally rather than ruined settlements.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are a static reminder whose meaning is already supplied by report.
changed_reading.after: The dwellings invite reproducible investigation: move, inspect, read the surviving trace, and let reason convert visibility into restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence first fixes bodies to the ground in their abode, then pairs clear proofs with pride and culpability, and finally models chosen protectors as a weak woven house. Historical dwellings and relational shelters become two scales of the same failed architecture of stability.

activation_trace.role: The place of settled rest supplies the focus architecture whose stability is reassessed.
The branch image of residence and its inhabitant supplies the immediate domestic site of the aftermath.
The branch image of sticking to the ground and remaining in place turns settlement into terminal immobility.
Manifest disclosure supplies proofs that are present despite the next movement of pride.
The branch image of greatness and pride supplies the posture that prevents clear proof from governing movement.
The branch image of offense and guilt supplies the agency attached to each material outcome.
The branch image of affectionate support and alliance supplies the relational material from which the shelter is built.
The branch image of the weaving spider supplies construction that looks like shelter while lacking strength.
The branch image of home and refuge supplies the explicit small-scale analogue to the focus dwellings.
The branch image of weakened force supplies the hidden structural defect of the apparent refuge.
The branch image of a likeness functioning as lesson and sign makes the weak house diagnostic rather than decorative.
The branch image of intellect restraining ignorance supplies the faculty needed to read that architecture.

structural_cues: 29:37, the focus ayah, and 29:39-40 form a sequence of abode, visible proof, pride, and culpable outcome.
29:41-43 immediately recast protective affiliation as a house whose weakness must be intellectually read.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies domestic stasis, visible proof, pride, culpability, allied protectors, and a weak house; I infer that the focus dwellings and the parabolic house diagnose false stability at material and relational scales, while the live alternative is that the parable concerns affiliation independently of the ruins.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings only preserve evidence of a past disaster.
changed_reading.after: They expose a failed security design: pride and chosen supports can produce an inhabited-looking structure that cannot carry the life entrusted to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later practice is described as checking reprehensible action while God knows what people make. This supplies an action-level countermechanism to beautification: repeated embodied orientation can inhibit conduct where unaided insight does not.

activation_trace.role: Displayed beauty supplies the positive pull that an inhibitory practice must counter.
Purposive action supplies the behavioral level at which attraction and inhibition compete.
The branch image of the specified worship practice supplies repeated embodied orientation rather than bare cognition.
The branch image of checking and restraining an act supplies the direct counterforce to attractive wrongdoing.
The branch image of making something by skilled action keeps the diagnostic focused on produced conduct.

structural_cues: 29:45 explicitly places a repeated practice in a restraining relation to ugly and rejected action.
The ayah closes by returning divine knowledge to what people actively make.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies practice, inhibition, and made conduct; I infer a behavioral control loop opposite to satanic beautification, while the live alternative is that the restraining relation is normative promise rather than a described mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The only missing element is better understanding.
changed_reading.after: Understanding needs an embodied inhibitor: the struggle occurs at repeated action, where practice can check what beautification makes attractive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs can reside in breasts and be held by people of knowledge while denial remains knowing; later, speakers give a correct answer and are immediately described as turned, then fail to reason from another correct answer. The focus insight can therefore be literal yet nonbinding at commitment and inference.

activation_trace.role: Heart-sight supplies real inward discernment rather than a necessarily sarcastic label.
Turning away supplies the behavioral result that real cognition fails to prevent.
The branch image of denial with knowledge directly supplies cognition coexisting with refusal.
Manifest signs supply content that is internally present rather than unavailable.
The branch image of the source from which actions issue places the signs inside the action-generating interior.
The branch image of disclosure to the knower supplies genuine possession of knowledge.
The branch image of voiced speech supplies an overtly correct answer that still does not govern orientation.
The branch image of turning something from its direction supplies the broken transition from premise to orientation.
The branch image of intellect restraining ignorance supplies the inferential restraint absent after another correct answer.

structural_cues: 29:47-49 place manifest signs in breasts and pair knowledge with knowing denial.
29:61-63 stage correct answers immediately beside being turned and failing to reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies internal signs, knowledge, knowing denial, correct speech, directional reversal, and failed restraint; I infer two separate breaks, commitment and inference, while the live alternative is that the spoken answers are polemical admissions rather than stable cognition.

changed_reading.before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is ironic because genuinely discerning people could not be diverted.
changed_reading.after: The term may be fully literal: knowledge can be internally possessed and verbally correct while denial, inference, and conduct remain uncoupled from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worldly life is framed as distracting occupation and aimless action; danger then strips competing supports and produces exclusive devotion, while rescue is followed by renewed association. Beautification is a state-dependent salience regime, not permanent blindness.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the ordinary-state salience that occupies conduct.
The branch image of a condition occurring in time lets discernment be read as present in one state without ruling every state.
The branch image of being occupied away from one thing by another supplies attentional displacement.
The branch image of action without a sound aim supplies energetic but misdirected conduct.
The branch image of exclusive separation from association supplies crisis-induced clearing of competing commitments.
The branch image of escape by separation supplies the transition back into safety.
The branch image of association with God supplies the restored ordinary pattern after rescue.

structural_cues: 29:64 names distraction and action without sound aim immediately before the crisis scene.
29:65 sequences exclusive devotion under danger, rescue, and renewed association without introducing new evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distraction, aimless action, crisis purification, escape, and renewed association; I infer that changing salience toggles which known commitment governs action, while the live alternative is simple rhetorical inconsistency rather than a psychological state-switch.

changed_reading.before: Insight is either present or absent as a stable trait.
changed_reading.after: Insight can remain available yet become behaviorally active only when crisis strips attractive alternatives, then lose control again when ordinary salience returns.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root occurrence binds experienced sanctuary-security and believing, while direct sight also registers people being snatched around it; belief is nevertheless assigned to falsehood. The failure is misallocation of trust despite correctly differentiated evidence.

activation_trace.role: Heart-sight supplies the focus capacity whose trust-allocation is at issue.
The branch image of eye-sight and insight supplies explicit recognition of the security contrast.
The branch image of settled security and trust binds the secure sanctuary and the later act of believing within one supplied root occurrence.
The branch image of swift snatching supplies the visible insecurity surrounding the sanctuary.
The branch image of losing truth and stability supplies the false object to which trust is assigned.

structural_cues: 29:67 begins with an appeal to seeing and juxtaposes secure space with surrounding seizure.
Its single ء م ن occurrence record spans both 'secure' and 'believe,' followed by belief in the unstable false.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sight, experienced security, surrounding seizure, shared security-belief morphology, and falsehood; I infer displacement of trust from read evidence to a false object, while the live alternative is that the shared root is wordplay without causal force.

changed_reading.before: They see truth but irrationally choose its opposite.
changed_reading.after: They discriminate security correctly at the perceptual level yet assign settled trust to the wrong object; discernment and allegiance follow different maps.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing counter-sequence joins strenuous exertion to gentle direction into plural paths. Against the focus sequence of insight plus blocked singular path, it makes committed movement the converter that turns discernment into guidance.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the failed motion that the closing counter-sequence reverses.
The extended traversable route supplies the singular blocked course.
The branch image of expending capacity under hardship supplies committed motion beyond passive insight.
The branch image of gentle direction to road and truth supplies responsive guidance.
The extended roads, now plural in the source, supply opened courses that answer exertion.

structural_cues: The final ayah gives an explicit exertion-to-guidance relation.
It repeats the focus path root in the plural after the focus's singular blocked path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hardship-bearing effort, guidance, and plural roads; I infer that enacted commitment is the missing converter between insight and traversable guidance, while the live alternative is that singular and plural path forms are stylistic rather than contrastive.

changed_reading.before: More perception would have prevented diversion.
changed_reading.after: Perception alone remains inert; strenuous committed movement is answered by guidance that opens paths where attractive action had blocked the path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the peripheral س ب ل branch of an eye-film resembling woven webbing, not the ordinary road sense. It remains anchored because the focus itself joins سَبِيل to مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ and 29:41 supplies an actual weaving spider and a weak structure. Downstream prose should mark it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a lexical translation of ٱلسَّبِيل.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of an eye-film like spider web supplies a thin visual obstruction latent beside the ordinary path branch.
The branch image of ocular sight keeps the material analogy anchored in the focus's own vision construction.
The branch image of the weaving spider supplies the web-material activated by the distant focus branch.
The branch image of weak force explains how a fragile covering can still occlude sight without being a strong barrier.

changed_reading.before: The road is blocked by a strong external barrier.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, beautification lays a weak web-like film across the field of sight: discernment persists beneath an obstruction too fragile to justify its power.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping under the proper name عَادًا; the dominant branch still identifies the tribe, so counting is not offered as etymology or translation. It remains worth carrying because 29:40 follows the named cases with 'each' and an offense-linked outcome. Downstream prose should present it only as a split-root formal resonance that makes the passage read like a case ledger.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant branch image of enumerating what is counted turns the first proper-name object into an exploratory ledger cue.
The branch image of manifest disclosure makes each named site an inspectable case rather than a bare item in a list.
The branch image of total inclusion supplies the following 'each' that closes over the enumerated cases.
The branch image of offense and guilt supplies the case variable linked to each distinct outcome.

changed_reading.before: Aad and Thamud are simply two remembered peoples.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, their names open a ledger of inspectable cases in which each settled trace records an offense-outcome relation.

strongest_changes: The focus shifts from ignorance to nonconversion: external evidence, heart-sight, internal signs, and correct speech can all coexist with diversion.
Beautification operates through self-authored work, rival-path assurances, shared affection, public normalization, and the diverted person's own obstruction of others.
Dwellings become both field evidence and failed security architecture, linking material remains to the later weak-house model.
The surah supplies action-level countermechanisms: restraining practice, crisis purification of salience, and strenuous effort answered by guidance.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly crossed sight with action, path with recruitment and obstruction, and dwelling with shelter and weakness. Its split-root inventories also preserved two contained formal activations that a conservative focus-only reading would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ may denote moral discernment, worldly acumen, or both; the trace does not force one.
The propagation from satanic beautification to social bonding and road-cutting is a reader-supplied causal arrow, though every stage is packet-anchored.
The webbed-path and counted-ledger readings are branch resonances only and must not be rendered as lexical glosses.
